data.mediaFolderHint: Where this workspace keeps its media on this machine: renders, takes, stills. kilna looks into each work's folder under it and never changes a file there. Its files stay yours: a backup and an export do not copy them. The place itself belongs to this machine and stays out of the profile.

restoreSteps.close: Close kilna. If it is working behind the tray, choose Quit kilna on its icon: closing the window does not close it while something goes.
restoreSteps.aside: Move {{file}} and the media folder somewhere safe, and delete {{file}}-wal and {{file}}-shm if they are there.
restoreSteps.copy: Copy the backup’s file here and name it {{file}}. If a folder ending in .media lies beside the backup, copy it here too and name it media.
restoreSteps.open: Open kilna. A backup from an older version is brought up to date as it opens; one from a newer version asks you to update kilna first.

data.restoreLeft: Your media folder of renders and takes is not in a backup, and stays where it is. Neither are this window’s theme and language, or the plugins.
data.bringInHint: Bring works in from files, a folder or a pasted text. A page kilna wrote and a .kilna.zip packed from a card come back as the works they were - versions, scores, release and, in a parcel, files. Any other .md or .txt becomes a new work. What is already here is passed over, never rewritten.
data.backupsHint: kilna keeps a copy of this space’s database by itself: the first time it is opened on a day, before a newer kilna changes its shape, and before a backup is put back - the last 7, 3 and 3. They lie in the “backups” folder of the space. The files of the space are not in them and stay where they are.

styles.phraseHint: Written into a text word for word, as the generator reads it.

editor.labLine: Works of this kind are experiments: a board of trials, each heard and kept or dropped.
